paris/neighborhood-1.title: File:Abadía de Saint-Germain-des-Prés, París, Francia, 2022-11-01, DD 20-22 HDR.jpg
paris/neighborhood-1.author: Diego Delso
paris/neighborhood-1.description: Choir of the  Abbey of Saint-Germain-des-Prés , Paris, France. The church is located in the  Saint-Germain-des-Prés  quarter and was originally the church of a  Benedictine  abbey founded in 558 by Childebert I, the son of  Clovis , King of the Franks. It was destroyed by the  Vikings , rebuilt, and renamed in the 8th century for  Saint Germain , an early Bishop of the city.  it was rebuilt with elements in the new Gothic style in the eleventh century. It is considered the oldest existing church in Paris.

londres/region-list-1.title: File:Puente de la Torre, Londres, Inglaterra, 2014-08-11, DD 092.JPG
londres/region-list-1.author: Diego Delso
londres/region-list-1.description: The  Tower Bridge  is a  bascule  and  suspension bridge  located in the center of London that crosses the  River Thames . Its name is taken from the  Tower of London , located nearby and has become an iconic symbol of London. The bridge was built between 1886 and 1894 and has a length of 244 m (800 feet) and the height of the towers is 65 m (213 feet). The 61 m (200 feet) long central span is split into two equal bascules than can be raised 86 degrees to allow the transit of ships. Otherwise the bridge is open to the traffic and to the pedestrians.

istambul/day-0.author: Diego Delso
istambul/day-0.description: View of the  Basilica Cistern ,  Istanbul , Turkey. The Basilica Cistern, or Cisterna Basilica is the largest of several hundred ancient  cisterns  that lie beneath the city. This subterranean cistern was called Basilica because it was located under a large public square, the Stoa Basilica, on the  First Hill of Constantinople .
